noun_definition: composer refers to the user interface element that allows users to input and edit messages in the Expensify application.

Screen size refers to the dimensions of the display on which the Expensify application is being used, specifically when transitioning from a mobile width to a web or tablet width during comment editing.
Comment editing refers to the process of modifying a previously sent message within a conversation in the Expensify application.
Expensify refers to the application or platform where users can log in to send and edit messages within conversations.
